title: Tor-independent stalk comparison for a perfect pullback
statement: Let f:X\to S and g:S'\to S be morphisms of schemes and form the cartesian square X'=X\times_S S' with projections g_X:X'\to X and f':X'\to S' [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume f and g are Tor independent in the stalkwise sense: for every x\in X and s'\in S' over the same s\in S, \operatorname{Tor}_i^{\mathcal O_{S,s}}(\mathcal O_{X,x},\mathcal O_{S',s'})=0 for i>0. If P is a perfect complex on X [def-pc-perfect-complex], then for every x'\in X' with x=g_X(x'), s'=f'(x') and s=f(x), and every i\in\mathbf Z, the canonical map $$H^i(P_x\mathbin{\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}}\mathcal O_{S',s'})\mathbin{\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{S',s'}}}\mathcal O_{X',x'}\longrightarrow H^i\bigl((Lg_X^*P)_{x'}\bigr)$$ is an isomorphism [def-pc-derived-pullback].

source.place: Tag 08IB, lemma-compare-base-change: local affine reduction and the Tor-independent comparison of derived tensors

proof.text: Fix a pullback point z, an arbitrary K-flat sheaf representative K of P, a representing isomorphism Q(K) ≅ P, and a degree i. From the K-flat counit in exists_derivedPullback for the projection, obtain Lg_X^* Q(K) ≅ Q(g_X^* K). The natural stalk-pullback isomorphism gives a chain isomorphism from stalkTensorComplex to the stalk complex of g_X^* K, using tensorToStalk_spec to identify the A-to-C ring map. Exactness of the stalk functor commutes it with cohomology; the derived homology factor isomorphism and the given representative isomorphism give the required nonempty identification of the target with the stalk of H^i(Lg_X^*P). These isomorphisms are constructed in the private proved helper kFlat_pullback_stalk_cohomology; neither perfectness nor Tor independence is needed for this part.

K-flatness of K implies A-K-flatness of its stalk at x by the stalk criterion. Specialize hTor to the projections x,t and point_eq. The actual left and right stalk algebra maps satisfy the equations of the fibre-product stalk flatness lemma, with tensorToStalk_spec providing both restrictions to the projection maps. Hence C is flat over E=A tensor_R B. Apply the Tor-independent A-K-flat algebraic comparison to this stalk complex and its existing cohomologyModel, giving IsIso of the specified localizedComparison. This avoids the bounded perfect model and all affine-restriction bookkeeping.

For every target-coordinate isomorphism e, composition of the canonical localizedComparison with e.hom is an isomorphism, since each factor is one. Together with the target identification from step 1, this proves IsComparisonIso for every K-flat representative and every degree, hence for every z. The Lean statement retains its perfectness assumption unchanged, though this shorter proof does not need it.
